messages:
Rina Patel: thinking about a concise 40m webinar: 'Webinar: Choosing the right inference playbook' — audience: infra + product. focus: topic selection, abstracts, speakers, rehearsals, run-of-show.
Owen Lee: sounds good. short and tactical wins. sample run-of-show idea: intro (3m), taxonomy (7m), 3 cost levers (10m), demo (10m), customer snapshot (5m), Q&A+CTA (5m).
Maya Li: agree on timing. I'll draft two abstracts: one technical, one business-facing. will share by EOD.
Samir Patel: speakers: runtime (us), bench (Ben?), demo (Samir), customer (if available). need slide deadlines and 1 full dress.
Jules Marin: registration fields: name, email, company, role, company_size, hosting_interest, primary_challenge. route enterprise-sized leads to AE queue.
Rina Patel: promotion plan: announce + 2 reminders, 1 partner blast. A/B subject lines: technical vs ROI. track CTA clicks per slide.
Maya Li: rehearsal plan: tech check 48h before (20m), full dress 24h before (45m), greenroom 10m prior. slides due 5 days before.
Owen Lee: demo fallback: pre-record demo and have eng in greenroom to hot-swap if live fails.
Samir Patel: I'll create the demo script and sandbox checklist. need eng-oncall for rehearsal.
Nora-bot: calendar created: 'Choosing the right inference playbook  final rehearsal' scheduled 2024-06-25T16:00Z. Link: https://calendar.redwoodinference/internal/meet-999
Rina Patel: great. next steps: Maya drafts abstracts, Samir preps demo script, Jules sets up reg form, Owen coordinates customer ask. update by Tue morning. :thumbsup:
